newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CROWN STRENGTHENS AFTER C.BANK COMMENT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CROWN STRENGTHENS AFTER C.BANK COMMENT.

text.p: 1315 GMT - The Slovak crown strengthens in afternoon trading as the market calms down after a statement from the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) that it was ready to support the currency.

*The Slovak crown stengthens to around -0.50 percent against the mark/dollar parity after what dealers say are massive sales of crowns by foreign banks pull it to levels of about 70 basis points below the midpoint before the NBS announcement.
*Dealers said the central bank comment gave direction to the market but that further development will still remain closely related to the situation with the Czech crown.
*Some traders said they saw the crown ranging between parity and 100 basis points below parity, at which point they though the NBS could intervene.
